# ADR-3036: A03: Documented dangerous-HTML allowlist for CMS block 12

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Rich content conflicts with strict sanitization.

## Decision

CMS platforms MAY adopt a documented dangerous-HTML allowlist for CMS block 12 (A03-12) when marketing requires rich content.

## Consequences

Allow-lists are versioned and tested.
